text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day as well, Efforia was quietly reading in order to read through every single book in the library—

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: —Good morning, Eff-san.

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: Reading again since morning. You're amazing, doing this every day.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Not at all. For the destiny bestowed upon me, I am merely doing what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Taiho-san, were you training in the mountains since morning again today?

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Since we have a mock race in class today, I held back a bit compared to usual, but...

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to beat you. —I won't let down my guard, and I won't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I merely follow my destiny. —If that destiny is 'victory', then I shall simply 'win'.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa~. Eff-san and Taiho-san are throwing serious sparks again for this in-class mock race!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...But surely Taiho-san takes the win today, right? Eff-san's been doing nothing but reading lately, so she might be out of shape...

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: (Out of shape? No, if anything—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: (Eff-san is completely serious. She is genuinely trying to read every book in the library.)

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
(—All for the sake of winning races.
Her absolute resolve comes through with every stride...!)

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: But I won't let you pass!

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
I am going to become the "strongest living creature"!
So... I won't lose to you!

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
Here she comes! On the outside!
—Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: —I will not let you go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
!? Eff-san!?
Kh...!

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: —She's pulling away, further and further!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: This race—I shall be the one to win it.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
For that is the destiny determined for me by history and this era.
—The very purpose of my existence.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
To run.
To win.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Following my destiny—I will run straight through!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
First place, Efforia!
Second place, Title Holder, 3 horse lengths behind!
Third place is...—

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: Three lengths behind...

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
...Having zero hesitation is proof of true strength.
Today, Eff-san really was the "strongest".

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: ...No matter how far ahead I was, I could still feel your fierce presence right behind me the entire time.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Being pursued by a wild beast...
I imagine it must feel something like that.

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: Then... next time, I'll become the "strongest wild beast" and defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
No.
I will simply claim victory—just as destiny commands.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While observing the mock race for guidance insights, I happened to witness Efforia's brilliant performance.
choice_data_list: Maybe reading all those books really did help.
Maybe reading all those books really did help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While observing the mock race for guidance insights, I happened to witness Efforia's brilliant performance.
choice_data_list: Maybe reading all those books really did help.
Maybe reading all those books really did help.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
choice_data_list: Have you prepared a reward for yourself?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I don't personally prepare such things myself. However...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Congrats on winning the mock race! Eff!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
, Epi-san.
...That's quite massive.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! 'Cause I just knew you'd win, Eff!
Cesario and I prepared it together!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You worked hard, Eff! Eat tons of it!
We packed in a whole bunch of pears too!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
No...
Victory is simply destiny.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Even without such things, I shall still win.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Are you referring to Taiho-san?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it's lucky having her in the same class.
Yeah, it's lucky having her in the same class.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Lucky...

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
I definitely think luck's on our side.
Because we get to have high-level races right in class.

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can get my rematch right away.
I'm glad we're in the same class.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then perhaps that is true.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: So as not to lose to her, I will continue to diligently hone myself.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
For the time being—
I shall continue reading through all the books in the library.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
...Me too.
Maybe I should read more books before complaining so much.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...Though reading all of them is definitely impossible.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Ah, Eff-san! If you know any books that might be helpful for racing, could you recommend some?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Me, you say?

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We know you read a ton... and if it's a book recommended by you, Eff-san, I feel like I could push through and finish it.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Then I will select a few for you by tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Woah, thank you~! Good luck with reading through the whole library!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Efforia
choice_data_list: Your straightforward attitude also has a big influence on everyone.
Your straightforward attitude also has a big influence on everyone.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all.
It is entirely thanks to your guidance, Trainer.
